entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We finally landed a big target.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, let's get some dirt on Madarame.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I was thinking about some things and[n]didn't notice how much time had passed.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't you think Kitagawa-kun has to be[n]protecting Madarame?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean they live together, so he'd have to[n]be aware of Madarame's true nature.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The only reason I can think of him doing[n]that is that Madarame has something[n]on him...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But that's why we're goin' to check it out,[n]right? You ready to be a model?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Something seem different about her[n]to you?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hm? But I'm the same as always.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno, I feel like she's got more makeup[n]on or something.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Nope, I'm the same as always.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kitagawa-kun seemed really happy when[n]I agreed to be his model.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Once he finishes drawing and gets a little[n]friendlier, we should bring up Madarame.
